entities.name: Ribosomal RNA small subunit methyltransferase G
observations: The 244-residue query is an exact sequence match to UniProt C1D0A7 from Deinococcus deserti.
Specifically methylates the N7 position of guanine 527 in 16S rRNA.
Belongs to the soluble cytosolic GidB methyltransferase family; homologs are annotated in Deinococcus species.
Predicted molecular weight is 26.47 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.13.
Pfam domains: GidB (PF02527) at residues 26–203 and Methyltransf_31 (PF13847) at residues 70–174.
No transmembrane or secretion features are indicated by the sequence analysis; the protein is expected to be cytosolic.
The C-terminal region around residues 225–244 is annotated as disordered/compositionally biased in the exact reference protein.

entities.name: 16S rRNA G527 methylation
observations: Guanosine 527 in 16S rRNA is methylated at N7 using S-adenosyl-L-methionine, producing N7-methylguanosine and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Rhea references reported by the protein analysis include RHEA:10209, RHEA:10210, and RHEA:42732.

entities.name: 16S rRNA modification
observations: The protein participates in bacterial small-subunit rRNA maturation or modification through site-specific guanine-N7 methylation.
